reference: Unchanged selected six-model stoppage consensus, not the rejected broadcast replacement screen.
reason: The initial broadcast screen provides a new same-camera signal for the missed33-frame possession, but broad joint replacement overextends control and regresses longer-block primary. Nearest-team evidence also disagrees with correct tactical evidence on another short possession. This motivates source-bounded intervals with independent learned agreement and reference-island protection.
hypotheses_ranked: A broad learned ownership run can contain a useful short interval whose endpoints are clearer in the aligned broadcast view. Source-defined intervals should avoid inheriting the learned run's full extent.

Some broadcast track team assignments are wrong. Requiring majority agreement from the independently fitted joint model and preserving nested brief reference runs should reject isolated contradictory source proposals.
Fine physical averaging may still blur a short touch. Compare fixed5-frame and11-frame source averaging without changing any other gate.
data: Reuse the strictly aligned observation-only cache and frozen seed42 broadcast joint-frame/run models. No new fitting, target-derived endpoints, media, private labels, annotations or final frame patches. Existing source alignment remains unchanged.

inference.source: Within each contiguous aligned observed-broadcast-ball episode inside one decode block, smooth same-camera conditional control shares over5 or11frames and decode H/A with penalty3. Missing observations split episodes; never carry control through a missing stretch.
inference.proposal: Source-decoded runs8..125frames, non-edge in the overall decode block, mean source confidence>=.65, and>=3 instantaneous same-camera exclusive contacts (distance<2m, advantage>.5m). No referenceD overlap. Require opposite reference ownership on a majority of each neighboring13frames and majority (>=.5) same-team support from the canonical broadcast-joint replacement prediction inside the proposal. All proposals/gates read unchanged reference and learned predictions.
inference.protection: Reject a proposal wholly enclosed by an opposite-owner reference run of8..250frames (twice the maximum proposal duration). This avoids punching a new island inside an already brief recognized possession. It does not lock every overlap or use true run lengths.
inference.output: Replace only accepted model/source-proposed intervals. Preserve reference D exactly; no true endpoints, frame identifiers or manually chosen final labels enter inference.

confirmation: If a method passes all seed42 gates, freeze at most one unchanged method before scoring seeds43/44 across all protocols; refit the corresponding joint head per original folds and retain the same source interval procedure. Independent review and a valid reproducible full-match CSV are required before promotion.

promotion.all_pairs: No primary or mean-short-IoU regression, MacroF1>=reference-.005, no previously mostly recovered short run lost, and identical D masks.
promotion.substantial: Buffered primary gain>=.04 and an additional short IoU>=.5 match for every seed, with positive mean primary gain in both other protocols.
promotion.selection: Largest minimum primary gain across protocols, then mean short IoU, then11-frame source averaging. Report every clipped-block regression; otherwise preserve the current selected model.

limitations: Adaptive follow-up after inspecting initial same-fixture broadcast results, not an independent test. Source/model agreement can share errors. Actual camera timing has physical and synthetic checks but no supplied correspondence ground truth.
